messages.content: 曼聯的球員名單是什麼？

function.name: sports_team_get_top_scorer
function.description: Retrieve the top scorer of a sports team in a specific season. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

team.description: The name of the sports team.

season.description: The season of interest, e.g. 2020-2021 NBA season.

league.description: The league the team is part of. Default is 'NBA'.

message.content:
我目前無法直接查詢或列出曼聯（Manchester United）完整的球隊成員清單。若您想了解最新陣容，建議參考以下幾個可靠來源：

| 資料來源 | 如何取得 |
|----------|-----------|
| **官方網站** (https://www.manutd.com) | 前往「Team」→「Squad」頁面，即可看到所有正式註冊球員、編號與位置資訊。 |
| **英超聯賽官網** (https://premierleague.com/teams/ManUtd) | 在「Players」區塊查看當季登記球員及其統計數據。 |
| **Transfermarkt** (https://www.transfermarkt.co.uk/manchester-united/startseite/wettbewerb/LIVE) | 提供詳細球員資料，包括國籍、年齡、合同期限等。 |

如果需要特定年份或某段時間內的歷史名單，可在上述平台使用搜尋功能或瀏覽舊版新聞稿／報告。

如需進一步協助，例如提取特定球員的關鍵數值，我可以嘗試透過工具來獲得相關資訊；請隨時告知！
message.reasoning:

We need to provide answer manually or maybe we could fetch via web? But no tool available except sports_team_get_top_scorer which doesn't give full squad. So I should respond with an apology and say cannot retrieve entire roster due to lack of data. Alternatively, mention typical approach: check official website etc. Provide explanation.
